instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace generic mock test UI with the Date & Shift-wise PYQ Catalogue based on 25+ papers in Tejas 200.
2. Standardize global theme to Obsidian Black (#09090B) and Blood Red (#E11D48 / #991B1B) across all components.
3. Recreate the logo natively using SVG and Tailwind blood-red accents (avoid blurry or cropped image paste).
4. Ensure test cards dynamically display 'Start Test' for new papers, and 'View Result' + 'Attempt Again' for completed attempts.
5. Precision-map cropped solution images into the result solution navigator.
6. Ensure all interactive components include explicit data-testid attributes for E2E automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not break existing exam player state machine, timing mechanisms, or score calculation engines.
Do not create unrequested features or rapid fire games unless already backed by existing backend APIs.
Always maintain strict high contrast text legibility (slate-100 on dark backgrounds) with APCA adherence.
Use proper React JS (.js / .jsx) components and ensure all tool modifications pass standard validation.
